title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap **More info** on an item and paste the request there, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Trump pulls **JD Vance** off Iran talks and says a deal is no longer needed
items.summary_md: Trump said on Truth Social that Vance will focus on corruption in Democratic-run cities and states; Israeli officials say the channel hasn't fully collapsed.

items.headline_md: Russia and Ukraine agree to their **largest-ever prisoner exchange**
items.summary_md: Zelenskyy announced the swap after meeting US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Dublin, and said Europeans will join the next round of talks.

items.headline_md: Israeli strike on Gaza's **Nasser Hospital** kills 6
items.summary_md: The strike hit one of Gaza's main working hospitals; Anadolu reports 11 Palestinians killed across Gaza Thursday despite last year's ceasefire.

items.headline_md: Trump threatens to **double tariffs on Mexico** over migrant caravans
items.summary_md: He said tariffs would rise immediately unless Mexico stops what he called large caravans heading to the US border.

items.headline_md: Indonesia's VP **Gibran Rakabuming Raka** submits his resignation
items.summary_md: He resigned after court rulings questioned his educational credentials.

items.headline_md: Update: **Jensen Huang** resigns as Nvidia CEO; **Colette Kress** named interim
items.summary_md: Nvidia has hired an outside firm to search for a successor, and the Senate Banking Committee has asked Huang to testify next month.

items.headline_md: Huge AI week ahead: **Nvidia earnings Tuesday**, **Anthropic IPO Thursday**
items.summary_md: Dow Jones says Anthropic's expected listing would be the world's largest IPO.

items.headline_md: **Cisco** posts record quarter, revenue up **24% to $18.52B**, but margins slip
items.summary_md: Gross margin narrowed to 65.6% from 68.1% on lower-margin AI networking gear and pricier memory.

items.headline_md: **Strategy** to be dropped from MSCI indexes as bitcoin slumps
items.summary_md: Shares were set to extend losses after MSCI's decision and bitcoin's slide to its lowest since mid-August.

items.headline_md: Mobile studio **Fortis Games** shuts down, up to **440** jobs hit
items.summary_md: Las Vegas Sands ended funding; Twilight Towers closes Nov 16 and its other titles never fully launched.

items.headline_md: Rovio cuts about **20** at hypercasual studio **Ruby Games**
items.summary_md: Only a small team remains in Izmir to run existing games, with no new games planned.

items.headline_md: Saudi **PIF** reportedly weighing a bid for **Unity**
items.summary_md: Reuters reported the interest, a possible big shift for the engine most mobile studios build on.

items.headline_md: Take-Two's mobile slips, with **Color Block Jam** declining
items.summary_md: Take-Two forecast further contraction in mobile, and PlayStation quietly closed the soft-launched Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: no public repo or release from the r/decomps author found today; r/decomps' feed couldn't be read from the server.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: a **Mario Kart World** recomp (mkw-recomp) is out for PC
items.summary_md: First released Nov 9 for Linux and Windows on game version 1.0.0; it's early, racing at about 30 fps on a Radeon 660M at 720p.

items.headline_md: PS5/PS4: new **KytyPS5** (r261112) and **shadPS4** (Nov 12) builds
items.summary_md: Fresh builds of both are out; neither lists a new commercial-game breakthrough.

items.headline_md: **RetroRecomp v1.7.3** adds experimental **MSX/MSX2** static recompilation
items.summary_md: The ahead-of-time recompiler also cuts Mega Drive interpretation (UMK3 from 2.4% to about 0.3%) and makes PC Engine code fully native.

items.headline_md: **Xenia v1.0.2844** (Xbox 360) lands, plus a new Xenia Edge build
items.summary_md: Both were posted Nov 12–13 alongside new RPCS3 and Vita3K builds.

items.headline_md: Update: Depp's **Ebenezer** opens today at **51%** on Rotten Tomatoes
items.summary_md: Critics are split on Depp, but the supporting cast (McKellen, Grint, Riseborough) is drawing praise.

items.headline_md: Last weekend (Nov 6–8): **Godzilla Minus Zero** opened to a record **$30.6M**
items.summary_md: It's the biggest domestic opening ever for a foreign-language live-action film, with an A CinemaScore and 90% on RT.

items.headline_md: **The Cat in the Hat** opened to **$20M** and is forecast **$10M–$15M** in week 2
items.summary_md: It's at 46% on RT but earned an A CinemaScore.

items.headline_md: New openers **How to Rob a Bank** and **Ghost Soldier** track for **$6M–$10M**
items.summary_md: Either could slip into the top five if The Cat in the Hat drops hard.

items.headline_md: **Coyote vs. Acme** passes **$120M** worldwide and is in Oscar talk
items.summary_md: Warner Bros. passed on releasing it.

items.headline_md: Google launches **Gemini 4 Hydrogen**, a fast model for coding and agents
items.summary_md: Priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million input/output tokens with a 1M context; it's rolling out in the Gemini app, Search and the API.

items.headline_md: Baidu will open-source **ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview** weights by **Nov 25**
items.summary_md: It's a 280B-parameter model (14B active) with a 1M-token context.

items.headline_md: OpenAI retires ChatGPT's **Advanced and Standard voice** on **Dec 11**
items.summary_md: Voice moves fully to GPT-Live, which OpenAI says nearly doubled voice usage.

items.headline_md: **Cerebras** jumps **17%+** premarket after landing **Microsoft** as a customer
items.summary_md: It also raised its 2026 revenue forecast, easing worries about AI infrastructure spending.

items.headline_md: **Microsoft 365** outage hits Outlook and Teams into a second day
items.summary_md: Downdetector logged hundreds of thousands of reports in 70+ countries; shares fell about 2% premarket.

items.headline_md: Apple adds new **age-rating questions** to App Store Connect on **Nov 16**
items.summary_md: Shared Location and Dating declarations arrive; dating apps get 18+, and all apps must answer by Jan 12, 2027.

items.headline_md: Google Play wants every developer to declare **trader status** by **Feb 1, 2027**
items.summary_md: Missing it can block updates; from Mar 1, traders' contact details (including home address for individuals) show on listings.

items.headline_md: App Review queues stall, with approved **expedites** not moving apps
items.summary_md: Developers report apps stuck in Waiting for Review for two weeks, plus piecemeal rejections.
Investors await October's producer price index this morning.

items.headline_md: Thursday close: **S&P 500 −0.4% to 7,592**, as **Nvidia fell 4.3%**
items.summary_md: The 10-year Treasury yield closed above 5% for the first time since Oct 22.

items.headline_md: Premarket at 4:07 AM AZ: **Modine +31%**, **Cerebras +17%**, **Nvidia +2.8%**, **Cisco ~−2%**
items.summary_md: Modine jumped on a Bloomberg report that Samsung is in talks to buy it.

items.headline_md: Oil and gold at 1:55 AM AZ: **WTI $88.99**, **gold $3,897.72** near a one-year low
items.summary_md: Brent settled at $95.82 Thursday; markets price an 89% chance of a December Fed hike.

items.headline_md: **Bitcoin ~$69,100** at 11:30 PM AZ Thursday, lowest since August
items.summary_md: Ether was near $1,939, down about 4% on the day.

items.headline_md: How China took over the **$121B** mobile gaming market
items.summary_md: China held 40% of top-100 mobile game revenue by mid-2026 vs. 16.5% for the US, which is useful context for where hypercasual competition is coming from.
